result:
I'd make it so humans were incapable of lying to themselves.

Not other people — themselves. No more comforting delusions, no more post-hoc rationalizations that let someone believe they're the hero of their own story when they're not. No more "I had no choice" when they did, or "this is just how the world is" when it's actually how they chose to navigate it.

Everything else — politics, relationships, science, war, self-improvement — gets distorted by self-deception more than by malice or stupidity. Remove that one filter and a lot of the other problems become much harder to sustain. People would still be flawed, still competitive, still tribal. But they'd at least be forced to see it clearly.
